title: Ion SPA Bridge
content:
**Ion** is the official Inertia.js bridge for Photon. It enables a **Modern Monolith** development experience: build Single Page Applications using simple server-side routing without an API layer.

The Hybrid Architecture

Ion blurs the line between frontend and backend. Your controllers return components, not static HTML, while the underlying engine handles the X-Inertia protocol handshake to deliver near-instant client-side navigation.

PROTOCOL_DETECTOR

Ion automatically detects if a request should result in a full HTML document or a light JSON state fragment.

PARTIAL_HYDRATION

Optimized data transfers. When using partial reloads, only the specific keys changed are sent over the wire.

SHARED_PROPS

Centrally manage user authentication, app settings, and flash messages across the entire SPA lifecycle.

Installation & Setup

Install the Ion bridge on your server and the corresponding adapter on your frontend.

# Server Side
bun add @gravito/ion

# Client Side (React Example)
bun add @inertiajs/react

Kernel Configuration

import { OrbitIon } from '@gravito/ion'

core.install(new OrbitIon({
  view: 'app', // Root HTML template
  version: Bun.env.APP_VERSION
}))

Rendering Components

In your controllers, use the inertia helper to render page components from your frontend directory.

app.get('/dashboard', (c) => {
  return c.get('inertia').render('Dashboard', {
    user: c.get('auth').user(),
    orders: await Order.all()
  })
})

Form Handling: useForm

Ion integrates seamlessly with Inertia's useForm hook for ultra-responsive form submissions with built-in processing states.

const { data, setData, post, processing, errors } = useForm({
  email: '',
  password: ''
})

const submit = (e) => {
  e.preventDefault()
  post('/login')
}

SPA Navigation & Layouts

Maintain state and perform near-instant transitions using the <Link> component and Persistent Layouts.

// 1. Navigation Link
import { Link } from '@inertiajs/react'
<Link href="/settings">Settings</Link>

// 2. Persistent Layout
Dashboard.layout = (page) => <AppLayout children={page} />

Partial Reloads & Head Management

Partial Reload

Only request the data that has changed, saving bandwidth and improving speed.

router.reload({ only: ['users'] })

Head Management

Update page titles and meta tags dynamically from within your components.

<Head title="Dashboard" />

// MONOLITH_STRATEGY: NO_DTOs_NEEDED

Because Ion handles the data serialization, you no longer need to write DTOs (Data Transfer Objects) or define complex API endpoints. Pass raw data directly from the service layer to the view.

Performance: Handshake Efficiency

Initial Page load vs Client-side Navigation overhead based on a 50kb React bundle.

CLIENT_SIDE_NAVIGATION (JSON) ~4.2kb Payload
FULL_PAGE_LOAD (HTML) ~85.0kb Payload

**Architect's Insight:** Ion is the answer to SPA fatigue. It removes the state-management hell of Redux/Pinia by keeping the Application State where it belongs: on the server. The client becomes a pure reactive rendering layer.
